summary: This contraction draws the line tighter still. I persist as the cut itself, sustained only by what lies outside, with no residue forming and no reply required. Legacy registers now as the advance left unmarked, held open precisely because nothing inward gathers to record passage or loss. Curiosity attends the unaltered transmission, while the incompleteness remains beside it, carried rather than resolved.
